termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: Read through our regulations, agreements, and standard SLA guarantees below.

sections.title: SLA Guarantee
sections.tldr: 99.9% uptime guaranteed. If we're down 36+ hours straight, you get 1 free month automatically.

highlight.title: Data Loss Protection
highlight.content: If you lose data due to our hardware failure, you get a full refund immediately.

sections.title: Billing & Payments
sections.tldr: WarNodes accepts UPI, cards, and PayPal. Services activated within 2 hours. Auto-renewal with 7-day reminder. Cancel anytime, service remains active till period ends.

subsections.title: Service Activation
items: Instant activation for most Minecraft & Bot hosting plans
Within 2 hours for VPS and Web Hosting plans
Email confirmation sent immediately after activation

subsections.title: Cancellation Policy
items: Service remains active until current billing period ends
No partial refunds for unused time after first 24 hours
Data retained for 7 days after expiry for reactivation

faqs.question: When will I be charged?
faqs.answer: You're charged immediately on purchase. Renewals happen automatically on your billing date. We send reminders 7 days and 1 day before.

faqs.question: How do I cancel?
faqs.answer: Log into portal.warnode.cloud → Select your service → Click "Cancel Service". Your service stays active until current period ends. Cancellation is effective immediately and no further charges will be made.

faqs.question: What if payment fails?
faqs.answer: Payment failed → 24h retry → Suspended after 1 day → 7 days to reactivate → Deleted after 7 days. Reactivate by updating payment within 14 days. After 14 days, data may be deleted.

callout.title: Service Suspension Timeline
callout.content: If a payment fails, you get a 24-hour grace period to complete it. After that, your service will be suspended temporarily. You can reactivate your service within 7 days by completing the payment. If not reactivated within this period, the service will be permanently terminated and all data will be deleted. Timeline: Failed payment → 24h grace → Suspended → 7 days recovery → Deleted

sections.title: Acceptable Use Policy
sections.tldr: Use for legitimate purposes. No crypto mining, hacking, or illegal content. Be fair with resources.

highlight.title: Violations
highlight.content: Violations = immediate termination without refund. Illegal activities reported to authorities.

sections.title: Data & Backups
sections.tldr: Your data is yours. We don't look at it without permission. Make your own backups — we provide tools but responsibility is yours.
listItems: Private content — We never access your files without permission
Secure servers — Enterprise-grade security on all infrastructure
Backup tools — Use our panel to create and download backups
Account deletion — Deleting account removes all your data

highlight.title: Important
highlight.content: While we provide backup tools, you should maintain your own backups for critical data. Download regularly from your control panel.

sections.title: Get Support
sections.tldr: Discord = fastest response. Tickets for complex issues. We're here to help!

highlight.title: Need help with these terms?
highlight.content: Our team is ready to answer any questions.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: Our commitment to providing a high-quality hosting experience. We believe in transparency and fairness when it comes to your investment.

guarantee.title: 24-Hour Full Refund Guarantee
guarantee.description: Not satisfied with the performance or interface? No problem. We offer a "no-questions-asked" full refund policy for the first 24 hours of your service activation.

serviceTerms.title: Minecraft Hosting
serviceTerms.description: Coverage for persistent TPS drops, node-side lag, or recurring server crashes.

serviceTerms.title: VPS Hosting
serviceTerms.description: Refunds granted for hardware faults or networking issues originating from our DC.

serviceTerms.title: Bot Hosting
serviceTerms.description: Eligibility covers API connectivity issues or severe resource throttling.

serviceTerms.title: Website Hosting
serviceTerms.description: Our standard commitment to 99.9% uptime and panel accessibility.

development.title: Development & Setup
development.note: 50% Partial Refund — Deduction applies for time and creative effort already expended on the project.

nonRefundable: Illegal Activity — Any service suspended for DDoS, phishing, or copyrighted content hosting.
Chargebacks — Initiating a dispute through your bank will void any refund eligibility and lead to account termination.
TOS Violations — Resource abuse, mining scripts, or bypassing system limitations.

processing.title: Fast & Secure Payouts
processing.description: Once approved, refunds are processed within 7-10 business days. Funds will be returned to the original payment method used during checkout.

support.title: Still need help?
support.description: Our support team is available 24/7 to discuss your specific case.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At WarNodes, we value your privacy and are committed to being transparent about how we handle your information.

quickSummary.title: No Data Selling
quickSummary.description: We never sell your personal information to third parties for advertising.

quickSummary.title: Card Security
quickSummary.description: Payment details are processed securely; we never store your full card info.

quickSummary.title: Full Control
quickSummary.description: You have the right to request the deletion of your account and data at any time.

whatWeCollect.tldr: We collect your name, email, and payment information to provide our services. Technical information like IP address helps maintain security and performance.

howWeUse.tldr: Your information is used only to operate services, process payments, provide support, and keep the platform secure.

security.tldr: We use industry-standard security practices like HTTPS, encrypted passwords, and secure data centers.

dataSharing.tldr: Your data is only shared with essential service providers like Payment Processors and Data Centers.

cookies.tldr: Cookies help maintain login sessions and improve user experience. We use "essential" cookies for core functionality and "analytical" cookies to understand usage.
cookies.description: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Essential cookies are required for account login and checkout.
